about: Curation list for the CC0 humanoid bodies of the library (track E, 2026-10-07). research/gf-three/tools/cc0-bodies.mjs reads it: --fetch downloads each source GLB from Poly Pizza into research/gf-three/.cache/bodies/ (gitignored) and checks its sha256; each body is then reset to its bind pose, cleaned (drop: held weapons; recolor: material colours, sRGB, for a variant), normalised onto gf-humanoid-1 by tools/optimize.mjs (its own clips dropped), checked by rig-check, and written to library/bodies/<id>.glb with a sidecar <id>.json that tools/lib/char-bodies.mjs merges into bodies.json. Only sources whose Poly Pizza page said 'CC0 1.0' on the day they were retrieved are listed. tint: the materials the kit tints per player seat. tags: what the pitch matches a game's theme against (catalog.json → bodies); 'player' marks a body that works as everyone's character, 'enemy' one that reads as a foe.

bodies.label: Casual man
bodies.describe: a man in a T-shirt, jeans and trainers; the shirt takes the player colour

bodies.label: Casual woman
bodies.describe: a woman in a fitted white top, orange trousers and trainers; the top takes the player colour

bodies.label: Office worker
bodies.describe: a man in a dark business suit, white shirt and tie; the tie takes the player colour

bodies.label: Construction worker
bodies.describe: a moustached builder in a hard hat, hi-vis vest and work boots; the vest takes the player colour

bodies.label: Hoodie kid
bodies.describe: a young man in a hoodie, shorts and trainers; the hoodie takes the player colour

bodies.label: Punk
bodies.describe: a punk with a mohawk, crop top and ripped black trousers; the top and the mohawk take the player colour

bodies.label: Adventurer
bodies.describe: an explorer in a khaki shirt, shorts, belts and boots; the shirt takes the player colour

bodies.label: Zombie
bodies.describe: a chunky cartoon zombie: green skin, big bald head, lolling tongue, a belt, torn trousers and one red trainer

bodies.label: Office zombie
bodies.describe: a zombie office worker: grey-green skin, pale eyes, a light-blue short-sleeve work shirt and dark trousers

bodies.label: Woman in a dress
bodies.describe: a red-haired woman in a sleeveless dress with a gold belt; the dress takes the player colour
